title: Jayden Daniels reportedly wants LSU to return its copy of his Heisman Trophy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels reportedly wants LSU to return its copy of his Heisman Trophy
sources.description: The recent fight between Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels and LSU over the re-issuance of his number started with a demand that the school stop using his name, image, and likeness.
